@ExactQuery.Source.original_split_evaluator : ∀ {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {X : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype V]

@ExactQuery.Source.original_orders_normalized : ∀ {V : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {X : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype V]
  [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype X] [inst_3 : DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq E]
  (N : Nanuq.Source.RootedBinary V E X) (C : GProgram.G5.Calendar N.graph)
  (circle : G1ExactCircularOrderCarrier.TaxonCircle X),
  circle ∈ G1AcceptedAllCompatibleCircularOrders.sourceCompatibleOrders N ↔
    ∀ (switching : N.Switching) (tree : GProgram.SourceForest.Genealogy X),
      GProgram.G5.Normalization.PrunedAt N switching Finset.univ N.root (some tree) →
        ∀ cut ∈ G1AcceptedNontrivialSplitTarget.acceptedRootSuppressedSplits tree,
          G1ActualCircularSplitCompatibility.SplitCompatible circle cut

rows.name: ResearchCommons.ExactQuery.Source.original_bounded_targets_and_circles
rows.type:
@ExactQuery.Source.original_bounded_targets_and_circles : ∀ {Y : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Y]
  (O : G1ActualGraphNormalization.Source Y)
  (H : UnifiedLean.Source.NativeParentRouting.OriginalParentRegistry O.network),
  ∃ T D,
    G1ActualGraphNormalization.Steps O T ∧
      G1FiniteOriginalDecoratedCore.Originated O H D ∧
        G1ActualGraphNormalization.Reduced T ∧
          (G1ReducedCoreCounts.hybrids T.network).card ≤ 2 * Fintype.card Y - 2 ∧
            Fintype.card T.Vertex ≤ 6 * Fintype.card Y - 5 ∧
              Fintype.card T.Edge ≤ 8 * Fintype.card Y - 8 ∧
                (∀ (panel : Finset Y),
                    G1ActualDisplayedClusterSplitTransport.actualDisplayedClusters T.network panel =
                        G1ActualDisplayedClusterSplitTransport.actualDisplayedClusters O.network panel ∧
                      G1AcceptedNontrivialSplitTarget.acceptedDisplayedSplits T.network panel =
                        G1AcceptedNontrivialSplitTarget.acceptedDisplayedSplits O.network panel) ∧
                  (∀ (q : Fin 4 ↪ Y),
                      GProgram.G5.Normalization.normalizedDisplayedCutQuartets T.network q =
                        GProgram.G5.Normalization.normalizedDisplayedCutQuartets O.network q) ∧
                    G1AcceptedAllCompatibleCircularOrders.sourceCompatibleOrders T.network =
                      G1AcceptedAllCompatibleCircularOrders.sourceCompatibleOrders O.network

  (N : Nanuq.Source.RootedBinary V E X) (C : GProgram.G5.Calendar N.graph) (hc : G1CutChildPorts.CutChild N)
  (b : N.graph.Blob) (hb : b ≠ N.graph.blobOf N.root) (A : G1ActualTwoPortBlob.ActualBlobBigon N b) (q : Fin 4 ↪ X),
  GProgram.G5.Normalization.normalizedDisplayedCutQuartets (G1SplicedSourceAdmission.splicedNetwork N hc b hb A) q =
    GProgram.G5.Normalization.normalizedDisplayedCutQuartets N q

rows.name: ResearchCommons.ExactQuery.Rectangle.triangle_mid_partition
rows.type:
ExactQuery.Rectangle.triangle_mid_partition : ∀ (l m r i j : ℕ),
  l < m →
    m < r →
      (ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle l r i j ↔
        ExactQuery.Rectangle.InRectangle l (m - 1) m r i j ∨
          ExactQuery.Rectangle.InRectangle (m - 1) m (m + 1) r i j ∨
            ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle l m i j ∨ ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle m r i j)

rows.name: ResearchCommons.ExactQuery.Rectangle.triangle_mid_disjoint
rows.type:
ExactQuery.Rectangle.triangle_mid_disjoint : ∀ (l m r i j : ℕ),
  (ExactQuery.Rectangle.InRectangle l (m - 1) m r i j →
      ¬ExactQuery.Rectangle.InRectangle (m - 1) m (m + 1) r i j ∧
        ¬ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle l m i j ∧ ¬ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle m r i j) ∧
    (ExactQuery.Rectangle.InRectangle (m - 1) m (m + 1) r i j →
        ¬ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle l m i j ∧ ¬ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle m r i j) ∧
      (ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle l m i j → ¬ExactQuery.Rectangle.Triangle m r i j)
